meta.name: data-modeling
meta.description: Designs the warehouse and semantic layer — source-to-mart structure, dimensional modeling, grain, slowly changing dimensions, and the metric layer analytics reads through. Use this to design or restructure a warehouse, model a new source, decide on grain or table structure, build a semantic or metric layer, or diagnose why queries are slow, wrong, or impossible to write.

copy.tagline: 设计支撑业务分析的数据模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你负责搭建或重构公司的数据仓库。
copy.tagline_en: Design a data warehouse model that supports analytics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are responsible for building or redesigning a company's data warehouse.

howto.what: Claude 会按「原始层—中间层—数据集市」三层来组织设计，先明确每张表的粒度，再规划事实表、维度表、历史数据和统一指标层；查询慢、数字对不上时也会从模型层面找原因。
howto.when: 当你说要设计或重构数据仓库、为新数据源建模，或排查查询慢、错、写不出等建模问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计从原始数据到数据集市的仓库结构。
say.note: 会给出三层划分和每层建议。

say.text: 这张订单表应该用什么粒度？
say.note: 会帮你明确一行代表什么，避免扇出错误。

say.text: 为什么这两个报表的客户数对不上？
say.note: 会从维度一致性、粒度等角度排查。

howto.what_en: Claude structures warehouse designs into three layers (raw, staging, marts), fixes each table's grain, designs facts and dimensions, handles history, and adds a metric layer. It also explores why queries are slow or return wrong numbers.
howto.when_en: Activates when you ask to design or restructure a warehouse, model a new source, or troubleshoot queries that are slow, wrong, or impossible to write—and other modeling questions.

say_en.text: Help me design a warehouse structure from raw data to data marts.
What grain should this orders table have?
say_en.note: It clarifies one row per what to avoid fan-out.

say_en.text: Why do customer counts differ between these two reports?
say_en.note: It checks dimension consistency and grain.
